claims.statement: The cloned repository lives in a persistent /workspaces mount whose edits, additions and deletions survive stop/start and container rebuild. Persistence includes accidental deletion effects, not backup or protection from whole-codespace deletion. Outside /workspaces, image-dependent directories generally preserve changes across stop/start but not rebuild, with /tmp explicitly excepted from this generalization; the fragment does not fully specify that exception's retention. Non-root write access may be restricted while many images permit sudo root access, not a universal privilege grant or recommendation to elevate. No files, programs or privileges changed.

The global-navigation Codespaces entry opens the personal Your codespaces page. This navigation step is not authenticated inventory evidence, estate-wide listing completeness or permission to modify instances; no UI action occurred.
